_doc: Evidence module settings (engine/evidence.py). Rank 1 is the strongest source, 5 the weakest. domains and files map a host (or a file path under sources/ or a job's inputs/) to a rank; anything unlisted is rank 5. The tracked defaults are empty: each ecosystem gets its table from its charter's source policy (T2.1). Claim types: a [S:...] citation backs a 'fact' and needs a stored source of rank max_rank or better; [A:...] (the approver's recorded answers) and [G:<job>] (an approved artifact) back a 'decision' and never a fact. Unfetchable sources (pages built by JavaScript, unreadable files) cannot back a fact. Fetch caps are in config/caps.json. Machine-specific values (e.g. pdf_converter: the full path of the markitdown CLI installed as a uv tool) go in the untracked config/evidence.local.json, which overrides this file.
user_agent: ecosystem-factory-evidence/1.0 (source verification; one request at a time)
